supersedes.reason: Runtime QA showed that Dawn's tablet-down one-column utility produced oversized 653-874px recommendation cards; version 2 derives a two-column tablet transition while preserving the explicit one-column mobile authority and four-column Figma desktop authority.

authority.mobile: user requirement: exactly one recommended product per row

mobile.mainProduct: single-column native stack; media before information; balanced page gutters

tablet.mainProduct: native responsive composition without horizontal overflow
tablet.relatedProductsRationale: two columns prevent oversized single cards between phone and the Figma four-column desktop composition; a min-width-only tablet default plus a later explicit 990px four-column override covers every fractional viewport without a decimal dead zone

desktop.relatedCardHeightPolicy: 406px is the Figma minimum/nominal target; cards grow for merchant-variable titles, prices, variants, and native quick-add controls and must never clip content
